design_engine_standards.section_count_rule: Strictly variable (7 to 12+ sections) tailored directly to the business category. Never rigid or twin layouts.
design_engine_standards.animation_standard: Awwwards / One Page Love standard: IntersectionObserver scroll entrance reveals (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), interactive Before/After comparison sliders, dynamic price calculators, floating status pills, and interactive FAQ accordions.
design_engine_standards.photography_rule: 100% rich Unsplash/Pexels stock imagery across EVERY single section and card. Zero empty text voids. Real customer portrait avatars.

outreach_protocols.email_safety_rule: 100% clean plain-text/HTML emails. Zero open-tracking pixels or wrapped links to guarantee 95%+ Primary Inbox placement.
outreach_protocols.multichannel_outreach: 1-Click Direct WhatsApp Click-to-Chat (https://wa.me/{phone}?text=...) with pre-typed personalized pitch and Calendly link.
outreach_protocols.followup_sequence: 3-Step Conversational Ladder (Day 3 casual bump, Day 6 micro-value add, Day 10 graceful breakup)
